subject: Cy Young Award
query: has a rookie ever won the cy young
title: Has a rookie ever won the Cy Young? Yes, Fernando Valenzuela in 1981
answer: Yes. Fernando Valenzuela of the Los Angeles Dodgers won both the NL Cy Young Award and NL Rookie of the Year in 1981, and he remains the only pitcher in MLB history to win both in the same season. In 2026, Guardians lefty Parker Messick is a finalist for both AL Rookie of the Year and the AL Cy Young.
body:
Valenzuela went 13-7 with a 2.48 ERA in the strike-shortened 1981 season. He opened the year 8-0 with five shutouts and a 0.50 ERA, setting off "Fernandomania," and the Dodgers went on to win the 1981 World Series. He died in October 2024 at age 63.

The 2026 AL Rookie of the Year finalists are Kevin McGonigle (Tigers), Parker Messick (Guardians) and Payton Tolle (Red Sox). The AL Cy Young finalists are Dylan Cease (Blue Jays), Parker Messick (Guardians) and Cam Schlittler (Yankees). Rookie of the Year will be announced on Monday, Nov. 9, 2026, and the Cy Young on Wednesday, Nov. 11.

Both awards are voted on by members of the Baseball Writers' Association of America, with ballots submitted before the postseason starts.
